sonnet.problem: This true/false asks again whether the fourth beast differs from the earlier beasts. Card 4 in the same stop already asked that the four beasts are each different from one another (Daniel 7:3). It is the same fact, so it gets one question.
sonnet.rule: Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
